history.administration_response: The Development Coordination Office continues to work with the United Nations Sustainable Development Group to advance the implementation of the road map. In the meantime, work is ongoing to frame a new road map for the period 2025– 2028, based on the lessons learned during the 2022–2024 period.
history.board_assessment: Given that the objectives of the efficiency road map for 2022–2024 remain unfulfilled and that the new road map for 2025–2028 has yet to be finalized, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: In its role as secretariat to the Business Innovations Group, the Development Coordination Office has consistently raised concerns regarding implementation deviations in the efficiency road map with the United Nations Sustainable Development Group and will continue to do so. To support timely follow-up and promote transparency, the Office has developed dashboards for business operations strategy and common premises implementation and is in the process of extending this approach to global shared services and the common back office. These tools enable real-time monitoring and support targeted interventions. Furthermore, the Business Innovations Group, with the support of the Development Coordination Office, is actively refining methodologies and governance mechanisms to address deviations and strengthen the overall implementation of the efficiency road map.
